programmes.d: Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.
Frankie befriends an outlaw after his gang robs the train.
While investigating a train robbery, Matt Clark learns about Johnny Ringo; Frankie gets a job doing undercover work; Matt tracks Johnny down.
Former deputies plan on robbing a gold shipment after their brother is killed.

Matt and Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to track down Doc Holliday who they suspect is involved with the Clanton gang; while there, they meet famed sheriff Wyatt Earp and become part of the gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

Frank Leslie returns from prison to marry the widow of the man he killed; the dead man's brothers plan to exact their own form of justice, even though Sheriff Hollister has ordered them to get out of town by sundown.
While outnumbered, Hollister and Calibourne take on raiders to restore peace in Osage.
A rancher is shot by an unknown killer, and his daughter's lover is jailed.
A group of outlaws devises a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.
After Lucas kills a mountain man in a barroom brawl, his father arrives in North Fork determined to take revenge on Lucas and Marshal Torrance, once he breaks his other two boys out of jail.
A dying gunslinger attracts trouble to North Fork.
Bat bargains with outlaws to keep them from taking a widow's Medal of Honor; the thieves decide to rob Bat as well, making off with his money and cane along with the precious heirloom.

After three gunmen on the gallows receive amnesty for their participation in the Lincoln County War, they resume their life of crime, and Bat must help the local marshal bring them to justice once again.
Yancy and Administrator Colton attempt to combat superstition when a voodoo priestess terrorizes the city.
Mei Ling gets arrested for opium smuggling after ordering firecrackers from San Francisco.
A fugitive's romantic overtures enchant a young woman.
A Yankee commander must contend with mutiny as Confederate troops attack.
The pony express hires Josh to find the murderer of a rider who stole a diamond ring.
Josh tries to prevent the hanging of the prisoner he has just brought in.
A Union officer (Robert Ryan) joins the outlaw James and Younger brothers against a bounty hunter (Robert Preston).
A gunfighter (Robert Taylor) and a cowboy (Chad Everett) help a Mexican girl (Ana Martín) avenge the land-related murder of her parents.
A Kentucky woman (Eleanor Parker) catches a trapper (Robert Taylor) with a shotgun wedding, then chases him northwest.
A handsome visiting attorney gets involved with a pair of strange sisters.
A Cavalry officer is confronted with the loss of his sweetheart and the revenge of a frontiersman. Guest star: Ronald Reagan.
An Indian death curse haunts a frontier wife.
A father reunites with his daughter just as she is about to get married.
Two Civil War soldiers fight their own battle.
A boy and his crippled uncle dream of flight.
Cisco and Pancho prove that an office manager and his followers are murderers.
Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.
Call (Tommy Lee Jones) and Gus (Robert Duvall) are forced into a confrontation with an old enemy who kidnaps and brutalizes Lorena.
